headline: Winter-proof
subhead: Cold air, dry heat, thirsty skin.
intro: Indoor heating and cold winds dry skin out fast. A few basics help, and we can help you pick them.

points.title: Moisturize after washing
points.body: Apply a cream or balm within a few minutes of bathing, while skin is still slightly damp.

points.title: Go richer in winter
points.body: Thicker creams and balms can feel more comforting than light lotions on dry winter skin.

points.title: Don't forget your lips
points.body: Keep a lip balm in your pocket and apply it before heading out into the cold.
points.tip: Try not to lick dry lips.

points.title: Know when to ask
points.body: If dryness turns into a rash, cracking or itching that won't settle, talk to our pharmacist.
points.tip: Rashes can be a minor ailment visit.

cta_body: Our pharmacists are happy to help you choose.
caption_instagram:
4 winter dry skin fixes to save before the cold hits ❄️

Looking for dry skin relief in Toronto? Indoor heating and cold winds pull moisture from your skin. Moisturize right after washing, switch to a richer cream or balm for winter, keep a lip balm in your pocket, and ask a pharmacist if dryness turns into a rash or cracking. Our North York pharmacy carries body balms, face creams and lip care, and we're happy to help you choose.
